description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the training yard, a bigger stage: a wider square of packed brown earth inside higher crenellated grey stone walls with a small wooden gate, four straw training dummies on wooden poles, a long rack of blunt wooden swords, spears and round shields, two wooden practice posts wrapped in rope, a straw archery target against the wall, a stone bench and a water trough, nobody on the yard, no people and no figures

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
